Diwali Celebrations Lead to Hundreds of Injuries Across India

During Diwali celebrations, hundreds of people across India sustained injuries. At AIIMS Delhi, 42 burn cases and 110 eye injuries were reported on Diwali night, including an 8-year-old in critical condition. In Hyderabad, 60 individuals suffered eye injuries during Deepavali, with half of them being under 18 years old. Long queues were observed at AIIMS Delhi.
